run.name: Herc Holdings Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (HRI)
run.summary: Herc is a large, diversified equipment renter that is highly levered after its debt-funded H&E acquisition: gross debt is USD 8,080 million, or 4.18x trailing reported EBITDA, with liquidity of USD 2,100 million. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is HERC HOLDINGS INC.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 8,080; cash 66. LTM EBITDA 1,932 (calc), the only full post-acquisition window. Unadjusted: excludes the add-backs management uses. Management reports 3.90x on pro forma adjusted EBITDA (Q3 release page:4). Financing obligations (sale-leasebacks) and operating leases are outside both ratios.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM EBITDA 1,932 over LTM cash interest 530 (calc: 419 plus 313 less 202). Unadjusted EBITDA; cash paid for interest per the cash flow statement supplemental disclosure (Q3 10-Q page:6).

cash.basis: Cash. ABL availability under the borrowing base equals remaining capacity (2,034, net of 16 standby letters of credit); AR Facility fully drawn at 550, availability nil (Q3 10-Q page:18-19). AR Facility matures August 31, 2027. Surety-backed letters of credit of 39 are outside the ABL sublimit. Availability depends on the borrowing base.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA for FY2025 and executed legal terms are not supplied, so management's 3.90x leverage and covenant headroom cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: FY2025 adjusted EBITDA is not supplied, so management's 3.90x pro forma net leverage cannot be rebuilt; ratios here use unadjusted reported EBITDA.
